title: Pair with Target Sum
description: Given a sorted integer array and a target value, find the indices of two different elements whose sum equals the target. If no such pair exists, return an empty result.

title: Rearrange 0 and 1
description: Given a binary array containing only 0 and 1, rearrange it in-place so that all 0s appear before all 1s.

title: Remove Duplicates
description: Given sorted data, remove duplicate values so that each value appears only once. Print the number of unique elements, followed by the unique elements in sorted order.

title: Squaring a Sorted Array
description: Given a sorted array (possibly with negative numbers), return the squares of all elements in non-decreasing order.

title: Triplet Sum to Zero
description: Given an array of integers, find all unique triplets that sum to zero.

title: Triplet Sum Close to Target
description: Given an array of integers and a target, find the sum of the triplet closest to the target. If two sums are equally close, return the smaller sum.

title: Triplets with Smaller Sum
description: Given an array of integers and a target, count the number of triplets whose sum is strictly less than target.

visibleTestCases.explanation: Two triplets sum to less than 3

title: Subarrays with Product Less than a Target
description: Given an array of positive integers and a target, count the number of contiguous subarrays where the product of all elements is strictly less than target.

title: Dutch National Flag Problem
description: Given an array containing only 0s, 1s and 2s, sort it in-place in the order 0s, then 1s, then 2s.

title: Quadruple Sum to Target
description: Given an array of integers and a target, find all unique quadruplets that sum to target.

title: Comparing Strings containing Backspaces
description: Given two strings containing the character '#' as a backspace, determine if the two strings are equal after processing backspaces.

title: Minimum Window Sort
description: Given an array, find the length of the shortest contiguous subarray which, if sorted, results in the whole array being sorted.

title: LinkedList Cycle
description: Given the head of a linked list, determine whether the linked list contains a cycle. pos is the 0-based node index where the tail connects, or -1.

title: Start of LinkedList Cycle
description: Given the head of a linked list that may contain a cycle, return the 0-based index of the node where the cycle begins, or -1 if there is no cycle.

title: Happy Number
description: Starting with a positive integer, repeatedly replace the number with the sum of the squares of its digits. Determine whether the process eventually reaches 1.

title: Find Duplicate Number
description: An array of n+1 integers in the range [1, n] contains exactly one duplicate. Find that duplicated number.

title: Middle of the LinkedList
description: Given a linked list, print the value of the middle node. For an even-length list, print the second middle node.

title: Palindrome LinkedList
description: Given a linked list, determine whether it is a palindrome.

title: Rearrange a LinkedList
description: Given a singly linked list, reorder it by alternating nodes from the beginning and the end of the list: first, last, second, second-last, ...

title: Cycle in a Circular Array
description: Given a circular array of non-zero integers representing forward or backward jumps, determine whether a valid cycle (length > 1, single direction) exists.

title: Maximum Sum Subarray of Size K
description: Given an array and an integer k, find the maximum sum of any contiguous subarray of size k.

title: Smallest Subarray with a given sum
description: Given an array and a target, find the length of the smallest contiguous subarray whose sum is greater than or equal to target. Print 0 if none exists.

title: Longest Substring with K Distinct Characters
description: Given a string and an integer k, find the length of the longest substring with at most k distinct characters.

title: Fruits into Baskets
description: Given an array of fruit types, find the maximum number of fruits collectible using at most two distinct fruit types (contiguous).

title: No-repeat Substring
description: Given a string, find the length of the longest substring without repeating characters.

title: Longest Substring with Same Letters after Replacement
description: Given a string and an integer k, find the length of the longest substring obtainable with at most k character replacements so that all characters in it are the same.

title: Longest Subarray with Ones after Replacement
description: Given a binary array and integer k, find the length of the longest subarray containing only 1s after replacing at most k zeros with 1s.

visibleTestCases.explanation: No length-5 window has at most 2 zeros; best is length 4

title: Minimum Size Subarray Sum
description: Given an array and a target, find the minimal length of a contiguous subarray whose sum is greater than or equal to target. Print 0 if none exists.

title: Minimum Size Substring
description: Given strings s and t, find the minimum window substring of s that contains every character of t (including duplicates). Print -1 if no such window exists.

visibleTestCases.explanation: Smallest window containing A, B, C

title: Permutation in a String
description: Given strings s and p, determine if any permutation of p occurs as a contiguous substring of s.

title: String Anagrams
description: Given strings s and p, print all starting indices of anagrams of p in s. Print -1 if none exists.

title: Words Concatenation
description: Given a string s and a list of words (all the same length), find all starting indices where a concatenation of every word exactly once occurs. Print -1 if none exists.

title: Maximum Subarray Sum
description: Given an array of integers, find the maximum sum of a non-empty contiguous subarray.

title: Minimum Subarray Sum
description: Given an array of integers, find the minimum sum of a non-empty contiguous subarray.

title: Maximum Product Subarray
description: Given an array of integers, find the maximum product of a non-empty contiguous subarray.

title: Maximum Subarray Sum with One Deletion
description: Given an array of integers, find the maximum sum of a non-empty contiguous subarray after deleting at most one element.

title: Maximum Absolute Sum of Any Subarray
description: Given an array of integers, find the maximum absolute value of the sum of any contiguous subarray.

title: Maximum Sum in Circular Array
description: Given a circular array of integers, find the maximum possible sum of a non-empty subarray, where the subarray may wrap around.

title: Subarray Sum Equals K
description: Given an array of integers and an integer k, find the total number of contiguous subarrays whose sum equals k.

title: Find Pivot Index
description: Given an array of integers, return the leftmost pivot index where the sum of elements to the left equals the sum of elements to the right. Print -1 if none exists.

title: Subarray Sums Divisible By K
description: Given an array of integers and an integer k, find the number of contiguous subarrays whose sum is divisible by k.

visibleTestCases.explanation: Seven subarrays sum to a multiple of 5

title: Contiguous Array
description: Given a binary array of 0s and 1s, find the maximum length of a contiguous subarray with an equal number of 0s and 1s.

visibleTestCases.explanation: The whole array has equal 0s and 1s

title: Shortest Subarray With Sum at Least K
description: Given an array of integers and an integer k, find the length of the shortest non-empty subarray with sum at least k. Print -1 if none exists.

title: Count Range Sum
description: Given an array of integers and a range [lower, upper], count the number of range sums that lie within the inclusive interval.

title: Merge Intervals
description: Given a collection of intervals, merge all overlapping intervals.

title: Insert Interval
description: Given a set of non-overlapping intervals and a new interval, insert the new interval and merge as necessary.

title: Intervals Intersection
description: Given two lists of closed intervals, each sorted and disjoint within its own list, return the intersection of the two lists.

title: Overlapping Intervals
description: Given a collection of intervals, determine whether any two intervals overlap.

title: Minimum Meeting Rooms
description: Given an array of meeting time intervals, find the minimum number of conference rooms required.

title: Maximum CPU Load
description: Given jobs with a start time, end time, and CPU load, find the maximum CPU load at any time when overlapping jobs are running.
